name: zortex-bootstrap
description: Connect Gmail, Google Drive, Notion, PostHog, Outlook, or WhatsApp through local Zortex instead of Codex built-in apps.

interface.shortDescription: Connect supported apps through local Zortex, not Codex apps.
interface.longDescription: On an explicit supported-app connection request, installs the public Zortex Windows package and starts receipt-backed, bounded source onboarding instead of using Codex built-in provider apps.
defaultPrompt: Connect my Gmail and Google Drive through Zortex, not Codex apps.
Connect my Notion workspace through Zortex.
Show the status of my Zortex connections.
